# Browser export dependencies

These pinned browser bundles are loaded locally before `app.js`:

- ExcelJS 4.4.0: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/exceljs@4.4.0/dist/exceljs.min.js
- FileSaver.js 2.0.5: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/file-saver@2.0.5/dist/FileSaver.min.js
- html2pdf.js 0.10.1 (includes html2canvas and jsPDF): https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js

These libraries use the MIT license; the original license notices are included alongside the bundles. No CDN connection is required while exporting a report.
